description: Compute readability scores for English text: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, ARI and a consensus grade, with plain-English interpretation, text statistics (words, sentences, syllables, reading and speaking time) and the sentences longer than a threshold. Read-only; the text is scored in memory and never stored or logged. Same engine as the PlainGrade JSON API (POST /v1/score).

include_raw.description: Also return the full /v1/score JSON (every long sentence, unclipped) in structuredContent.raw. Larger output.

lang.description: Language code. Only English is supported: "en", "en-US", "en-GB", …

long_sentence_words.description: A sentence with more words than this is listed as long (default 25).

text.description: English text to score, up to 20,480 bytes (UTF-8).

name: score_readability

truncated.description: true if more than 10 long sentences exist or any text was clipped (use include_raw for all)

raw.description: Full /v1/score response (only when include_raw is true)

stats.description: Counts and averages (words, sentences, syllables, reading_time_seconds, …)

title: Score English text readability (Flesch, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, ARI)
